name: Backrest
author: lorenzo-vecchio
description: Backrest backup health, recent history, and one-click backups in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: See Backrest status at a glance, browse recent backups, and start a backup for any plan.

schema.label: Backrest URL
schema.description: Base URL of the Backrest web UI, for example http://127.0.0.1:9898 or https://backup.example.com.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often status is polled. While a backup is running the widget polls every 5 seconds.

schema.label: Show last backup age in the bar
schema.description: Show a compact age such as 2h next to the bar icon.

schema.label: Bearer token (optional)
schema.description: JWT from a Backrest login. Preferred over username and password when authentication is enabled.

schema.label: Username (optional)
schema.description: Used to log in only when no bearer token is set.

schema.label: Password (optional)
schema.description: Stored in plain text in shell.json. Prefer a bearer token when possible.
